title: LoopSkim: Lossless Multi-Depth Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.19896v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped language models such as Ouro and Raven apply one weight-shared block several times per token, so autoregressive decoding (AR) runs every loop of every token in sequence. Pipelined self-speculative decoders overlap these loops by drafting tokens from shallow readouts and verifying them at full depth. Yet every loop of a looped LM ends in a readout of the next token, and draft tokens pass through every depth anyway, so each depth can check them without an extra pass. We introduce LoopSkim, in which the depth of the pipeline is the verifier. Draft tokens copied from the context, as in prompt lookup decoding, enter after the first loops, any later readout that contradicts one replaces it at that depth, and only full-depth readouts commit tokens. translated_title: LoopSkim：面向循环语言模型的无损多深度投机解码
translated_abstract: 诸如Ouro和Raven之类的循环语言模型在每个token上多次应用同一权重共享的块，因此自回归解码（AR）需要按顺序运行每个token的每一层循环。流水线式自投机解码器通过从浅层读出生成草稿token并在全深度进行验证来重叠这些循环。然而，循环语言模型的每一层循环都以对下一个token的读出结束，且草稿token无论如何都会经过每个深度，因此每个深度都可以在无需额外前向传播的情况下对其进行检查。我们提出了LoopSkim，其中流水线的深度本身就是验证器。从上下文复制的草稿token（如提示查找解码那样）在首轮循环之后进入，任何后续与草稿矛盾的读出都会在该深度将其替换，只有全深度的读出才会提交token。LoopSkim预先固定每个位置的随机抽样，因此每次检查只需比较两个token，并且在采样条件下，对于任意数量的检查和草稿，解码在精确算术下保持无损。
tldr: LoopSkim提出了一种面向循环语言模型的无损多深度投机解码方法，让流水线的每个深度直接验证从上下文复制的草稿token而无需额外前向传播，在保持解码无损的前提下显著加速。
en_tdlr: LoopSkim enables lossless multi-depth speculative decoding for looped language models by letting each pipeline depth directly verify draft tokens copied from the context without extra passes, accelerating decoding while remaining lossless.
